description_en: Queries the details of an artifact building rule
name: GetArtifactBuildRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Container Registry instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The effective range of the artifact building rule. Valid values:

`REPOSITORY`: The artifact building rule is effective in the repository level
parameters.help_zh:
规则生效范围，取值：
`REPOSITORY`：表示生效范围仓库级别
parameters.name: scope_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the effective range of the artifact building rule.

Set the value to the ID of the image repository
parameters.help_zh:
规则生效范围的ID，取值：

ScopeId配置为镜像仓库ID
parameters.name: scope_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the artifact.

`ACCELERATED_IMAGE`: accelerated images
parameters.help_zh:
加速镜像类型，取值：

`ACCELERATED_IMAGE`：表示生成加速镜像
parameters.name: artifact_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the artifact building rule
parameters.name: build_rule_id

200: Indicates success.
Others: Indicate error codes

PriorityFile.description_zh: 加速镜像预取文件列表，每行一个绝对路径，通过Base64 编码

The parameter value is the ID of the image repository
